reason: I never remember to take pills at home, so one tear-and-go sachet I can toss in my bag is what gets me. At $24.99 with a money-back guarantee I'd try one box if a creator I follow shows it, it's cheap enough to be an impulse buy.
objection: It's still two capsules a day and I pay more per day than a regular bottle of magnesium at the store. I don't know if it will actually help me sleep, and I'd quit by week two if I don't feel anything.
would_change_my_mind: If the price were closer to $35 or higher for one box, or if I saw no real mom on TikTok using it, I'd scroll past.
